name: The Adventurer
summary: From Northshire Valley, Marshal McBride sends you toward Goldshire to find Sam Sarsaparilla. You have proved your skill defending the abbey, and now he wants you to look into a newcomer.

sections.title: Leaving the Valley
sections.body: With the Defias and vermin threats easing, McBride turns his attention to the road beyond the valley. His garrison needs promising fighters to watch travelers and wanderers in the surrounding woods.

sections.title: A Curious Newcomer
sections.body: Marshal McBride asks you to check on Sam Sarsaparilla, who was spotted near Goldshire. This is neither a military order nor a hunt for a bounty. The newcomer draws you from Northshire’s secluded valley into Elwynn’s wider wilds.

faq.q: Who sends me on this task?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride, commander of Stormwind's garrison in Northshire Valley, sends you after you prove your mettle defending the abbey.
Sam Sarsaparilla is an adventurer near the road by Goldshire. Marshal McBride hears he is there and asks you to find out what he is doing.

faq.q: Where do I find Sam Sarsaparilla?
faq.answer: Sam Sarsaparilla is along the main road south from Northshire toward Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why does Marshal McBride care about a random adventurer?
faq.answer: Northshire remains on alert for bandits and intruders. McBride keeps watch on unfamiliar sellswords and wanderers passing through, and trusts dependable locals to make first contact.

faq.q: Do I need to leave Northshire Valley to finish this?
faq.answer: Yes. Leave Northshire Valley through its southern gates and follow the forest road toward Goldshire.

faq.q: Is this part of the normal Stormwind military chain of command?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride is a Stormwind officer, but he calls this an unusual assignment rather than standard guard duty. He relies on your judgment as an independent protector, outside formal military protocol.

angles.text: For new Alliance recruits finishing their service in Northshire, this is your first official step into the wider realm of Elwynn Forest.
As a human defender leaving Northshire Abbey, you take your first steps toward Goldshire, the heart of Elwynn.
